messages.author: 6f9739ea511c7a89
messages.subject: html issues with Shiny 0.4.0
parts:
Guys,

In shiny 0.3, I used to put reactive outputs side by side in my ui.R, by pasting html tables with the output.  Here's an example:

  mainPanel(
               HTML(paste("<table><tr><td>",
                          uiOutput("category_list"),
                          "</td><td>",
                          radioButtons("segments","Pick segment",c(1:5)),"</td></tr></table>"),"</td><td>",
                          tableOutput("blah")))

But now in 0.4.0, it seems shiny doesn't pick up anything past the first output ... so in the above case, radioButtons() and tableOutput don't render, and since shiny thinks its hidden, all the related reactive outputs don't execute.  If I take everything out of the table, it all works fine.

Is there a better way to do this?  Or perhaps is this a bug in 04.0?

Keep rocking guys!
John
